ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Gravship Landing Reveal
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
GRAVSHIP_LANDING_FOG_REVEAL_1 (owner, 2026-09-12): you cannot pick a landing spot you cannot see.
When a gravship arrives at a tile with no map, vanilla generates the map, reserves a landing area near the centre and fogs everything except the flood-fill from that one spot. If the spot lands inside a walled complex (ruins, a junkyard, an injected structure) the landing picker shows a single room and the rest of the map is black — so the player lands blind.
This mod runs after vanilla's GravshipMarker gen step on gravship-arrival maps and unfogs every OUTDOOR region (unroofed cells), exactly what vanilla's own edge-unfog does on maps with no start spot. Roofed interiors — mountains, sealed rooms, dungeons — stay fogged.
Mod Settings: one toggle, "Reveal the outdoors before choosing a landing spot" (default on). Off = vanilla behaviour.
